verdict.rationale: Proa documents async renderers (docs-13) and Suspense boundaries that stream slow data out of order (docs-17), with typed loader caching through WebContext (docs-18). It also documents interactive islands that emit server-rendered HTML plus island JavaScript (gh-3), each hydrated with seed state (docs-16), which covers the core of fetching on the server and handing data to client components. missing for 10: explicit documentation or example of passing props from an async server component into a hydrated island, independent or hands-on corroboration.
